jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:

The organization operates within the technology sector, focusing on designing and securing infrastructure for its clients. It addresses the challenge of maintaining high standards for internal technology environments in a remote-first setting, ensuring that its own operations reflect the quality delivered to clients. The company integrates AI governance and security practices to enhance both internal and client-facing technology solutions.

The DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY is responsible for leading and managing the internal technology environment. This role involves setting the technology strategy, building and developing the IT team, and overseeing the adoption and governance of AI within the organization. The position plays a vital role in ensuring that the internal IT infrastructure operates at the same high standard as client-facing solutions, contributing to overall organizational effectiveness and security.

Develop and execute a multi-year internal technology roadmap covering identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, and service management
Align technology investments with business outcomes and define success metrics
Determine which IT functions are handled internally versus through partners
Establish IT governance, standards, architecture review, and change management processes
Design and build the internal IT team, including headcount planning and hiring
Mentor the team and define ownership, on-call, and escalation procedures
Develop an internal service catalog with defined service levels
Lead internal AI tool development, rollout, training, and adoption measurement
Collaborate with AI practice teams to inform client delivery
Manage AI financial engineering, including cost modeling and consumption forecasting
Oversee endpoint management and device lifecycle processes
Manage Microsoft 365 collaboration tools and enforce device requirements for a remote workforce
Own internal network architecture, remote access, and secure connectivity
Manage cloud and hosting resources, including capacity and cost
Ensure backup, recovery, and business continuity with tested recovery objectives
Establish and mature IT service management processes
Publish operational metrics and reduce employee friction points
Manage onboarding and offboarding technology experiences with HR
Oversee IT budget, forecasting, and software license management
Rationalize SaaS applications and manage vendor relationships and contracts
Partner with security leadership to execute security programs and support compliance audits
Manage vulnerability assessment and remediation for internal systems

Requirements:

Minimum 10 years in information technology with leadership or technology ownership experience
Proven ability to build and scale IT in a distributed or remote-first fast-growth environment
Experience presenting technology strategies and metrics to executives
Expertise in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management (Intune or equivalent), and SaaS at scale
Experience with internal AI adoption, governance, and change management
Strong security knowledge and ability to collaborate with CISOs and communicate risks to executives

The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

jobs.description:
Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Eastern or Central time zones.

As a Senior Manager, CTEM & Vulnerability Management, you will lead the enterprise Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and Vulnerability Management function across enterprise IT, cloud, operational technology (OT), and product environments. You will partner with Product Security, Threat Intelligence, Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Engineering teams to reduce exposure through risk-based discovery, prioritization, validation, and remediation.

What you will do:

Technical Responsibilities:

Lead the enterprise CTEM and Vulnerability Management program, including its strategy, roadmap, and operating model.
Oversee vulnerability scanning and assessment across infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, application, identity, network, and OT environments.
Manage the product security vulnerability lifecycle with Product Security, including intake, triage, risk assessment, remediation tracking, software bill of materials (SBOM) analysis, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure support.
Prioritize vulnerabilities and exposures using CVSS, EPSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), threat intelligence, asset criticality, and business context.
Lead attack surface management, exposure validation, and breach and attack simulation activities to confirm exploitability and control effectiveness.
Evaluate emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, and threat intelligence affecting enterprise systems, marketed products, and embedded systems.
Drive automation for vulnerability discovery, data enrichment, ticketing, remediation workflows, and reporting through SOAR platforms, APIs, Python, or PowerShell.
Support cyber incident investigations with vulnerability context, exposure analysis, and remediation expertise.

Leadership & People Management Responsibilities:

Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Product Security, and Engineering teams to establish risk-based service-level agreements, drive remediation, and track plans of action and milestones.
Establish governance standards, quality assurance procedures, and documentation for vulnerability and exposure management operations.
Measure and report exposure reduction, remediation performance, validation results, and operational metrics to executive stakeholders.
Lead vulnerability management, exposure management, or product security vulnerability teams.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

Analyze complex vulnerability data and large volumes of exposure telemetry to identify risk and guide response.
Translate technical findings, remediation status, and risk trends into clear written, verbal, and presentation-ready updates for technical and executive audiences.

What You Need:

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity.
Minimum 3 years of experience leading vulnerability management, exposure management, or product security vulnerability teams.
Experience managing product vulnerabilities, including triage, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, SBOM analysis, and remediation with product engineering teams.
Experience with Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, or equivalent vulnerability and exposure management technologies.
Experience implementing automation through SOAR platforms, APIs, Python, or PowerShell.

Give Imperative read-only access to a customer’s cloud environment and the platform automatically discovers AI models, agents, endpoints, and available telemetry. It then begins measuring behavior, analyzing performance, identifying root causes, calculating business impact and trend scores, and delivering actionable solutions for performance improvement and maintenance.
Deploy nothing. Change nothing. See everything.

No agent. No SDK. No code. No plugin. No application changes. No software installation.

We are looking for a deeply experienced, highly technical startup technology leader who thrives in the earliest and most demanding stages of building a technology company — someone who can personally get into the architecture, code, AI systems, models, agents, telemetry, cloud infrastructure, product, and engineering organization and help take Imperative from its current stage to a production-ready, enterprise-grade platform.

Finish it. Fine-tune it. Train it. Validate it. Deploy it. Scale it.

Completing and fine-tuning the Imperative Performance AI product and Impertive platform.

Training, testing, validating, and optimizing Performance AI’s agents.

Establishing the technical standards, development processes, testing methodologies, security practices, and deployment processes necessary for commercialization.
Leading technical troubleshooting and resolving remaining product, infrastructure, AI, and engineering issues.

CTO — Imperative AI

Pre-Seed, AI Model Control and AI Performance Improvement Platform

Imperative AI is ready to launch “The Pluginless, Effortless Control Tower for AI Models, Agents, and Systems.”

Imperative is building a platform designed to give enterprises complete AI control, significantly improved AI performance, full maintenance visibility, and measurable business impact across their AI environments.
Give Imperative read-only access to a customer’s cloud environment and the platform automatically discovers AI models, agents, endpoints, and available telemetry. It then begins measuring behavior, analyzing performance, identifying root causes, calculating business impact and trend scores, and delivering actionable solutions for performance improvement and maintenance.
Deploy nothing. Change nothing. See everything.

No agent. No SDK. No code. No plugin. No application changes. No software installation.

Imperative connects to the customer’s cloud environment and can begin delivering visibility, control, and performance improvement with less than 15 minutes of customer effort.
NVIDIA Inception

Imperative is part of the exclusive NVIDIA Inception Program
, providing the company with access to NVIDIA’s broader AI ecosystem and resources as it advances its AI technology platform.

The CTO Opportunity – Initially Paid with Generous Stock Options until Pre-Seed funding has been established (should be shortly).

We are now looking for an exceptional Chief Technology Officer
to lead Imperative through the final stages of product development, technical refinement, AI model and agent training, pre-seed financing support, customer development partnerships, commercialization, and scale.
This is not a traditional corporate CTO position.
We are looking for a deeply experienced, highly technical startup technology leader who thrives in the earliest and most demanding stages of building a technology company — someone who can personally get into the architecture, code, AI systems, models, agents, telemetry, cloud infrastructure, product, and engineering organization and help take Imperative from its current stage to a production-ready, enterprise-grade platform.
The immediate mandate is clear:
Finish it. Fine-tune it. Train it. Validate it. Deploy it. Scale it.

The CTO will work closely with the founders to put the finishing touches on the Imperative Performance AI technology and prepare it for enterprise deployment.
What the CTO Will Lead

The CTO will have primary technical responsibility for:
Completing and fine-tuning the Imperative Performance AI product and Impertive platform.
Reviewing and improving the existing architecture and technical infrastructure.
Completing the Performance AI platform and preparing it for commercialization.
Training, testing, validating, and optimizing Performance AI’s agents.
Leveraging NVIDIA’s AI ecosystem and available NVIDIA technologies and resources.
Training models and AI capabilities using the appropriate NVIDIA AI agent technologies, including the available NVIDIA agent ecosystem.
Improving model performance, accuracy, reliability, responsiveness, and consistency.
Validating Imperative’s AI performance monitoring, drift detection, technology monitoring, resource monitoring, root-cause analysis, business-impact analysis, and actionable recommendations.
Ensuring the platform can operate effectively across enterprise cloud environments.
Execute the pluginless, effortless, agentless, SDK-free, code-free architecture and customer deployment model. Must be really good with Open Telemetry.
Ensuring Imperative can securely obtain and analyze available telemetry through read-only access to customer cloud environments.
Completing the technical integrations and infrastructure required for enterprise customer deployment.
Establishing the technical standards, development processes, testing methodologies, security practices, and deployment processes necessary for commercialization.
Leading technical troubleshooting and resolving remaining product, infrastructure, AI, and engineering issues.
Working directly with prospective customer development partners to understand technical requirements and rapidly incorporate validated requirements into the platform.
Preparing the technology organization for the transition from pre-seed development to commercial scale.

The Development Team

The ideal CTO candidate will already have — or have exceptionally strong relationships with — an experienced development team capable of working closely with the CTO during this critical final development phase. The development team will also work for options during this short sprint until the product is finished and funded.

We are looking for a CTO who can bring technical horsepower to the company
and work directly with a highly capable team to get the product across the finish line.
The CTO and development team should be comfortable operating with speed, urgency, and limited resources.
Who We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will bring:
Significant CTO, VP Engineering, founding engineer, and experience in a startup environment.
Experience building and launching cloud, AI, enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, observability, AI operations, and related technology platforms.
Demonstrated experience taking a technology platform from development through production and commercialization.
Deep hands-on experience with AI/ML systems, LLMs, AI agents, model training, inference environments, AI infrastructure, and enterprise AI architectures.
Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform
.
Working knowledge of GitHub, APIs, OpenTelemetry,
cloud services, inference infrastructure, data pipelines, model monitoring, and enterprise application architectures.
Experience designing systems that operate across complex enterprise technology environments.
Experience with AI model performance, model behavior, model drift, hallucination detection, latency, resource utilization, reliability, and related AI performance measurements.
The ability to personally diagnose technical problems and make architecture and engineering decisions rather than simply delegating them.
Experience with AI agents and multi-agent architectures.
Experience training, fine-tuning, testing, and validating AI models and agents.
Strong technical leadership and the ability to establish high standards for engineering quality, accountability, testing, documentation, and execution.
The ability to communicate effectively with technical founders, engineers, enterprise CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, AI leaders, investors, boards, strategic partners, and customers.
A highly dynamic, hands-on leadership style.
The ability to move extremely quickly from problem identification to technical solution.
A willingness to personally get into the technology when necessary.
Exceptional judgment, creativity, adaptability, persistence, and execution.
High personal standards for integrity, ownership, preparation, accountability, and results.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

This is an opportunity to join Imperative at an unusually important point in its development.
The core concept and Performance AI product are almost done.
The next phase is about finishing, validating, training, commercializing, and scaling the technology.

The CTO will have a significant opportunity to shape:
The final product architecture.
AI model and agent performance.
AI training and optimization.
Technical product strategy.
Engineering culture.
Development methodology.
Cloud architecture.
Enterprise deployment architecture.
Security architecture.
Scalability.
Technical roadmap.
AI agent capabilities.
Product-market fit from a technical perspective.
The company’s long-term technology organization.

This is an opportunity for a CTO who wants to build something rather than simply maintain something that already exists.

Imperative is currently approaching its pre-seed financing round
.
The CTO will work closely with the founders, board, advisors, and business leadership to help convert the existing technology into a production-ready and commercially scalable platform.

The Leadership Profile

The CTO who finishes what others started.

We are looking for an exceptional technical leader who is an unusually effective executor, builder, problem solver, and company builder.
Someone who doesn’t simply manage engineers — they understand the technology deeply enough to lead them.

Someone who is comfortable opening the codebase, reviewing architecture, analyzing AI behavior, debugging difficult problems, making technical decisions, training models, working with developers, talking with customers, and making whatever technical decisions are necessary to move the company forward.
Someone who thrives in an environment where:
Speed matters.

Results matter.
